Optimized Block Entities (OBE)

OBE is a fully client side mod that significantly improves the rendering speed of block entities but not just that!

You won't lose animations, this mod keeps the animations of animated block entities likes chest and shulker boxes, it also supports EMF and ETF , which means it is compatible with FA: Objects !

You should also check out Better Block Entities, it was the first mod to optimize block entities on 1.21+ and did that very well. Both mods do not work in the same way, but he gave me some inspiration and 1 or 2 clever tricks.

 How it works

This mod renders supported block entities just like any other block, this means they are meshed into the terrain and rendering terrain is much faster than rendering entities so it gives a HUGE performances boost. To keep animations, they are only rendered through the terrain when they are static, otherwise it go

accelerated-decay:
Accelerated Decay

 Leaves go bye-bye 

Accelerated Decay is an alternative fast leaf decay concept where instead of actually ticking the leaf blocks rapidly, we just remove them as soon as possible. Our mod implements this logic in the most vanilla possible way by delaying our leave checking logic to allow the game to naturally mark the leaves ready for removal. 

One of the goals of Accelerated Delay was reduce the lag on clients & servers. We've achieved this by using a time based checking system and heavily reducing the particals and ticking logic on blocks.

 

 How it works

Once the last block supporting leaves has been removed, the mod will attempt to seek out any leaves marked with the minecraft:leaves tag and remove them as long as they're ready to be decayed.

We support any tree made up with the minecraft:logs tag.

Coords HUD

 
 
 

This is a small server-side mod to provide fast and configurable HUD text to players. It's very similar to the "Coordinates HUD" datapack from Vanilla Tweaks!

 

It aims to provide some small improvements over the datapack:

- Allows custom server or player-specific HUD messages, using the Placeholder API
- Stores data in a config/db file, rather than including it in the world save
- More efficient for large servers, avoiding expensive processing and reducing sent packets

This was primarily built so that Minecraft BINGO players don't need to re-run the /trigger ch toggle command every time the server restarts with a new world. The customization with placeholders is a nice advantage.

Disclaimer

- NO, this is NOT an autoclicker. An autoclicker would mess up eating, block placing would be uncontrollable, XP bottles would be uncontrollable, charging anchors with just one glowstone would be a huge challenge and the list goes on. 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In Minecraft, binding right click to place blocks/use items sucks. It feels delayed and slow compared to just holding a keyboard keybind for it, and that's because keyboard keys repeat at a much faster rate. That happens even when both binds are simply being held, not clicked.

The only way to counter this is by spam clicking right click, which you can only do if you have high CPS. But even then, you will still be slower than just holding a keyboard button. Another way is rebinding right click to a keyboard letter then using that letter in ur keybind.

slipstream:
Slipstream

Slipstream is a client-side Minecraft performance mod for macOS that reduces the overhead of getting rendered frames onto your screen, sometimes up to tripling your fps or more in common scenarios!

 Features

- Bypasses the normal frame presentation path, displaying frames directly through macOS's compositor
- Supports OpenGL and Minecraft's Vulkan renderer
- Can improve FPS when frame presentation is a bottleneck; gains depend on your hardware, renderer, and modpack
- Allows the Metal Performance HUD to apply to Minecraft (if the environment variable MTL HUD ENABLED is set)

滑流 Slipstream是一款适用于macOS的客户端Minecraft性能模组，可减少将渲染帧传输到屏幕上的开销，有时在常见情况下可将fps提高三倍或更多！ 特征 - 简化普通帧呈现路径，直接通过macOS的合成器显示帧 - 支持OpenGL和Minecraft的Vulkan渲染器 - 当帧呈现是瓶颈时，可以提高帧数;收益取决于您的硬件，渲染器和整合包 - 允许Metal Performance HUD应用于Minecraft（如果设置了环境变量MTL HUD ENABLED）

create-big-cannons-equally-opposite:
Create Big Cannons: Equally Opposite

 OBSOLETE AS OF CREATE BIG CANNONS 5.11.3

Have you ever attached cannons from Create: Big Cannons to a Create: Aeronautics vehicle and were disappointed that you couldn't feel the recoil of them firing? Have you ever shot at a physics object and watch as the projectile simply caused some damage and bounced off it?

With this mod, both of these scenarios change. The blast of a cannon will rock your vehicle when fired. Enemy shells that slam into your boat might knock you off-course. For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction.

 Changes:
- Cannons and Autocannons from Create: Big Cannons will now generate recoil forces when fired from the physics object they are attached to.
- Cannon shells and Autocannon rounds will now generate impact forces when they hit a physics object.

This mod is compatible with Create Big Cannons: Going Ballist

In vanilla Minecraft a river is a long, flat strip of still water. Dynamic Waters turns it into a living water system. Lowland rivers wind across the land to the sea, cut valleys and gorges through the hills and fan out into deltas. Mountain rivers start where rain really gathers on your terrain, tumble down through pools, waterfalls and ravines, fill mountain lakes and join the big rivers at real confluences. And all of it flows: the current carries you, your boat, your items and the mobs downstream, foam drifts on the water and mist rises where the waterfalls land.

 

 Available for NeoForge 1.21.1, Fabric 1.21.1 and Forge 1.20.1.

pylon:
Pylon
Pylon allows legacy Minecraft versions to run with LWJGL 3. It replaces the outdated windowing system with SDL 3, and serves as a library for mods.

 Installation
 IMPORTANT:
 
 On versions older than 1.6 a deAWT mod is required. LegacyFix is recommended.

 Forge
Depending on the game version:
- 1.3 or older: Follow Other.
- 1.4: Put the mod jar into the .minecraft/coremods folder.
- 1.5 or newer: Put the mod jar into the .minecraft/mods folder.

 Fabric
Put the mod jar into the .minecraft/mods folder.

 Other
If you are playing on Vanilla or using an older mod loader (like Risugami's), you need to install Pylon as a Java Agent.

Pylon can also be put in place of LWJGL2 directly, but game patches won't be available.

 Features
 Fixes
- Lag from high-polling-rate mice
- Keys and mouse buttons getting stuck
- Crash when resizing the window on macOS

ore_deposits:
This small project adds ore deposits, little stone mounds that infinitely generate ore on top. Ore deposits are similar to ore nodes from the game Satisfactory. They are designed to be used with factory mods but can work in vanilla. They can generate ores from mods, as long as the ore generates at or above y=8 (and if they are in the mod loader's ore tag). Ores spawn as falling blocks, so they can be broken in vanilla. All overworld ores can spawn as deposits, meaning it can break the progression of the game.

The ore that an ore deposits will spawn is determined when it is first loaded. It will scan its chunk and use the first ore that it finds that is at or above y=8.

Older versions of this project will not scan and are only compatible with vanilla and create.

You are free to use this in any modpack.

Item Get! is a Minecraft mod that can pop up instructions to guide players when they trigger certain conditions.
 

 Features
- Item acquisition and entity kill counters
- Health, hunger, effect, weather, time, biome, and structure triggers
- Custom title, description, icon, sound, and singleplayer pause behavior
- Creative-tab item picker with full item NBT, including potion and enchanted-item variants
- Built-in, vanilla, modded, and user-provided sound selection
- External MP3 and OGG sound support
- Searchable selection lists and batch reminder management
- Per-player progress preserved across death, End return, logout, and rule edits
- Chinese and English localization

 Usage

This mod adds Copper Golems to your game.

To make one you have to place these Blocks on top of each other:

1. Cut Copper Stairs (on the Bottom)

2. Block of Copper or Cut Copper (in the Middle)

3. Lightning Rod (at the Top)

 

It pushes a button every 10 seconds.

It can oxidize just like copper blocks.

You can wax them with a honeycomb.

If a lightning strikes near, then it will be redirected to the golem.

If its unwaxed then it will be deoxidized when struck by lightning.

You can oxidize it faster when using an egg on it, and you can polish it with an axe.

It will rotate its head sometimes or when you use a copper ingot on it.

Can be tamed with a copper ingot, and then it will follow you when you are not too far away.

Can be healed with copper ingot.

Drops some Copper Ingots on death.

 

Hope you like it.

Polymorphic Occultism 

 
 
 

 

An add-on mod providing Polymorph support for the Storage Controller crafting terminal from Occultism, adding Polymorph's recipe selection button to the terminal in order to choose between conflicting crafting recipes instead of being forced to work with only one of these conflicting recipes within Occultism's storage system.

When a group of ingredients matches more than one recipe, a button will appear above the output slot. Clicking it shows a list of all possible results, selecting one changes the crafting output to match. Polymorph will remember the last selection as long as the ingredients don't change, allowing repeated crafting actions on the same selection.

 Required mods: Occultism, and either Polymorph or Polymorph+. Polymorph+ is recommended for the extra QoL features (scrollable conflict list, pinnable selector panel, first-run tutorial ove

FSR Upscaler for Minecraft

Get more FPS without making Minecraft look like a blurry mess. FSR Upscaler for Minecraft brings AMD's FSR technology to Minecraft, allowing the game to render at a lower resolution and then upscale the image to your display resolution.

 Supported FSR Versions

 FSR 1
 FSR 2
 FSR 3
 FSR 3 Frame Generation
 FSR 4 (Windows only) 

 Why Use This Mod?

Normally, getting more FPS means lowering Minecraft's resolution. While that can help performance, it also makes the game look noticeably worse.

This mod takes a different approach. Minecraft renders internally at a lower resolution, then FSR reconstructs the image at a higher resolution. Temporal upscaling uses information from previous frames to help preserve detail and reduce jagged edges.

 Sharper Graphics

FSR includes RCAS sharpening , which helps keep things like blocks, leaves, items, and other fine detai

Rising Toxicity 

Rising Toxicity introduces a toxic fog that rises over a set period of in-game days, forcing players to take to the skys to survive. This mod was designed to take advantage of Create Aeronautics (Not Required) by encouraging flying bases.

---

 🎥 Video
 

---

 ⚙️ Mechanics:
- Toxic fog rises over time to a set height (default 20 days) 
- Exposure builds in toxic air without a mask → damage at 100% 

- Masks prevent exposure but consume air 
- Masks fog up over time, reducing visibility and forcing you to surface 
- Air tanks refill mask capacity 
- Passive mobs take damage; hostile mobs are immune (Villagers, Wandering Traders, and some others are also immune) 
- Non-immune mobs can't spawn in the toxic fog. 
- Fully multiplayer compatible 
- Configurable heights, timing, and progression via commands 

---

- Gas Mask (Tier 1) – 1 tank capacity, 10 minutes

DemoBox
DemoBox is a tool for creating interactive demos for mods, originally created for BlanketCon '23.
It uses plasmid, the library behind nuceleoid games, to manage virtual worlds safely,
allowing users to experience mods in survival mode without risking them breaking things in the overworld.

 Usage
To create a demo using demobox, first build a structure and store it with a structure block. 
This structure will spawn in your demo worlds centered at 0, 0.

As of 26.1, demos are first created using the /demo create command. This command opens a dialog letting your configure the demo.
You can then use /demo open to open it, or /demo edit to modify it. 

Editing demos requires the demobox.edit command. This should not be given to untrusted players,
as it permits them to run arbitrary commands with gamemaster permissions. Opening demos requires the demobox.open permission.

Minecraft’s world has always hinted at trees that were either incomplete, reused from other types, or strangely missing. Missing Trees brings them to life with their own wood sets, blocks, and proper place in the world.

 

 Features

 Azalea Tree
Azaleas already exist in vanilla, but their wood is inexplicably oak. This mod finally gives Azaleas their own full wood set.

 

 Scots Pine
Pines appear in the game but simply reuse spruce blocks. Missing Trees introduces the Scots Pine (Pinus sylvestris), giving pines their own identity.

 

 Swamp Oak
Swamp biome trees are technically oaks but previously shared blocks with regular oak. In this mod, swamp oaks gain their own dedicated wood set, featuring a distinct darker tint—darker than oak yet lighter than dark oak—designed to better match their murky environment.

 A lightweight client-side Fabric mod that hands your repetitive keypresses to a macro 

Auto forward · Quick turn · Route cruising · Input recording & playback · Bulk container caching · Schematic water filling

 

---

 What it is for

When you build something large, reorganise a warehouse, or run a long supply route, the time does not

presses — it never rewrites your position and never sends malformed packets, so it behaves the same
in single-player, on a LAN world, and on a multiplayer server.

horse-powered:
Horse Powered

 

Pre-industrial farming machinery for Minecraft. Process grain, wood, fluids, and rock the old-fashioned way: by hand for the early game, then with leashed animals walking in circles once you have a herd. Every recipe, time, and tier is data-driven, so modpacks can re-balance the entire mod from a datapack.

 Highlights

 Two tiers for almost every machine: a hand-cranked starter block and an animal-powered upgrade
 Workers are any leashable mob (vanilla horses/donkeys/mules/llamas, plus anything in the horsepowered:valid worker tag)
 Attached workers become a virtual ghost render: the real mob is stored on the block so it can't be killed, despawned, or wander out of range; break the block and the original entity respawns with its full NBT intact
 Power generation tie-in: the Generator turns worker labor directly into Forge Energy for the rest of your tech setup

distributary:
A Minecraft reversed proxy that distribute connections to backend servers based on the host info in the handshake packet

In brief, this mod can recognize the server address used by the client when connecting to the server and use it as a routing identifier. When the address matches a given list, this mod will forward the client connection to a specified backend Minecraft server. At this point, the mod acts as a port forwarding tool. For those client connections that do not match any of the configured addresses, they will be directly connected to the current server as if this mod does not exist

hailwall:
HailWall — Mod Whitelist

 HailWall checks the mods installed on a player's client when they join, and kicks them if they have disallowed mods (or are missing a required one). It's a modern, lightweight take on the classic Mod Whitelist idea.

 ⚠️ Install it on BOTH the server and every client. A purely server-side mod cannot read a client's full mod list — vanilla simply doesn't send it. So, like every mod of this kind, HailWall needs a tiny companion running on the client.

 ✨ Features

- Whitelist mode (default) — block everything except the mods you allow. The essentials ( minecraft , the loader, java , hailwall ) are always allowed.
- Blacklist mode — allow everything except specific mods (cheat clients, x-ray, …).
- Required mods — kick players who are missing a mandatory mod.
- Operator bypass — server operators are never kicked, even with extra mods (like a usePermission toggle).

HailWall - 模组白名单 HailWall会在玩家加入时检查其客户端上安装的模组，如果有不允许的模组（或缺少必需的模组），就会将其踢出。 在️服务器和每个客户端都安装它。一个纯粹的服务器端模组不能读取客户端的完整模组列表- vanilla根本不会发送它。所以，像每一个这种模组一样，HailWall需要一个在客户端运行的小伙伴。 功能 - 白名单模式（默认）-屏蔽除你允许的模组之外的所有东西。基本的东西（minecraft，loader，java，hailwall）总是允许的。 - 黑名单模式-允许一切，除了特定的模组（欺骗客户端，X射线，.）。 - 必需的模组-踢球员谁是缺少一个强制性的模组。 - 操作员旁路-服务器操作员永远不会被踢，即使有额外的模组（如usePermission切换）。

A minimalist mod that introduces a single item: the Eternal Shield Bead.

By right-clicking on a creature while holding the bead, you grant it a permanent "Eternal Shield" effect. This effect cannot be removed by conventional means—affected entities become immune to death, always retaining 1% health upon receiving fatal damage. create-transcontinental:
Create: Transcontinental

Create: Transcontinental generates a continent-scale railway network for Create during chunk generation.

Building a full railway network can be a long process, especially on smp servers when players build their base far away from each other. This mod aims to provide a basic network, far from perfect but sufficiant to be a solid base for player to improve it to build their network.

Automatic FPS Target Balancing 

Set an FPS target and LoadShift adjusts your graphics settings to hit it.
It detects CPU and GPU bottlenecks in real time and automatically tunes the settings that matter most.

LoadShift is active right after install with a target of 120 FPS and starts
adjusting your video settings when you join a world. Change the target with
 /loadshift target or turn it off with /loadshift off .

 Your settings stay yours: every change is logged ( /loadshift status ), and
 /loadshift revert puts everything back and switches LoadShift off.

 What you get
- Best quality at your target FPS. When your game runs faster than the target,
 LoadShift raises quality. When it drops below, it lowers the setting that costs
 the most on whatever is limiting you (GPU or CPU). It only raises a setting
 when it predicts the FPS will hold, so it doesn't keep flipping back and forth.
-

This mod works by using SpongePowered Mixins to inject into the Java bytecode of Minecraft. Within the AbstractHorse class (used as the base for the main Horse entity type) there is a method with a mapped name of "handleEating", which has two parameters; one for the Player feeding the horse, another for the ItemStack being fed to the horse. BHF injects into the "head" of this method, applying the effects (if any) from the food being fed to the horse. It's that simple!

The cover polls its redstone input every 40 ticks to fix that sometimes the cover could malfunction and stop machine without signal or the other way around.

Removes the anvil's enchantment level clamp, so combining books above the vanilla cap (e.g. Sharpness VI, Protection V) applies the enchantment at its real level instead of silently dropping back to vanilla max.

 The problem this solves
Vanilla always clamps an enchantment's result on an anvil to its own getMaxLevel() , no matter what datapacks, loot table or other mods put into the book the user tries to apply.  NoMaxEnchant removes that clamp. Whatever level the anvil calculation would naturally produce is what applies, up to a hard ceiling of 255.

 Environment
 Server-side only. The mod only needs to run on the server; the anvil calculation it patches is server-authoritative.

villager-trade-trade:
Enchanted Book Trader

Ever found an enchanted book you didn't need, with no good way to use it? This mod turns that book into currency — and turns your local librarian into an actual book dealer.

 How it works

 Teach a trade: Right-click a librarian villager while holding an enchanted book. The villager consumes the book and adds a real trade to its offer list — you (or anyone) can buy that exact book back from it later for emeralds.

 Reroll for a better price: Got a duplicate of an enchantment type the villager already knows? Hand it over, and instead of teaching a new trade, it rerolls the existing one — new random price, the offered book updates to match the level you just gave it, and its stock fully restocks. It's a gamble each time.

 Only librarians deal in books. Other professions (and unemployed villagers) will ignore the book entirely — it stays safely in your hand.

this uses the vulkan mod to get better fps. how? vulkan is the base but i have added other mods that work with it. altogether, this is probably one of the best performance mods.

the modpack is probably more lightweight and has better performance

sodium still uses a modified version openGL to optomize the game. vulkan, hence the name, replaces openGL with vulkan renderer, which is way more performant, so yes i am highly positive it will work better as long your device was made in 2017 or later.

enchantments-rebalanced:
The goal of Enchantments Rebalanced is to improve unbalanced enchantments and to change how some enchantments are obtained, from an experienced player's perspective.

This datapack needs plenty of constructive feedback, whether it's positive, mixed, or negative. Please join the Discord server and share your thoughts or suggestions!
 

Enchantments Rebalanced was made with the standpoint that some enchantments are imbalanced, and that most enchantments can be obtained too easily.

 Don't expect your personal opinion to be validated and your own playstyle to be strengthened by Enchantments Rebalanced. 

 

 Summary
- Mending has been added to the Enchanting Table, and removed from librarian villagers
- Enchanting Table luck has been buffed
- Anvils are cheaper to craft and cheaper to enchant with
- Fletcher villager stick trade has been nerfed to make wood farms less effective

 Changes

从经验丰富的玩家的角度来看，魔法再平衡的目标是改善不平衡的魔法，并改变一些魔法的获得方式。 此数据包需要大量的建设性反馈，无论是正面的、混合的还是负面的。请加入Discord服务器并分享您的想法或建议！ 不要指望你的个人意见得到证实，你自己的游戏风格得到加强的附魔重新平衡。 总结 迷魂台的运气得到了强化 - 铁砧的制作成本和附魔成本都比较低 - 弗莱彻村民的木棍贸易已经削弱，使木材农场的效率降低 - 变化 - Fletcher villager stick trade has been nerfed to make wood farms less effective Changes

The train features permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSM) in its traction system, improving its energy efficiency compared to its predecessors. A derivative of the 1000 series operates on the Kyoto Main Line and its branches with alternate car body dimensions and different traction equipment, called the 1300 series.

This resource pack adds the Hankyu 1000 series to the Minecraft Transit Railway mod.

There are four types of cars for this train and you may configure them as you wish.

- Cab forwards
- Pantograph trailer
- Trailer
- Cab backwards

As Mojang has been slowly remastering the default textures of the game, they seem to have left some stragglers behind,  Reforged Mobs aims to fix that.  No Optifine or EMF required, this mod doesn't change any models.

- Ghast
- Witch
- Enderman
- Creeper
- Blaze
- Shulker

Other planned mobs are the Silverfish and Endermite.
 

The pack is likely not compatible with any animation or model changing packs like Fresh Animations.

cozy-autumn:
Cozy Autumn

------

This project completely overhauls the game's vanilla lighting engine to deliver a cinematic, hyper-realistic visual experience while maintaining balanced visibility for actual gameplay.

 Features

HDR Tone Mapping: Implements an ACES Filmic curve to compress raw linear light data, preventing blownout highlights and preserving deep, rich contrast in the shadows.

Dynamic Atmosphere: Features custom atmospheric scattering for realistic time-of-day color transitions, combined with exponential depth fog and procedural volumetric clouds.

AuraKills transforms the standard Minecraft PvP experience by introducing a dynamic aura system that rewards skilled players with increasing powers based on their kill count. As players defeat opponents, they progress through multiple aura stages, each unlocking new abilities and visual effects that showcase their prowess on the battlefield.

 Core Features

 Progressive Aura Stages
Players advance through four distinct aura stages by accumulating kills:

 Stage 0: No Aura (0-1 kills) 
- Standard vanilla gameplay with no enhancements
- Perfect for new players starting their journey

 Stage 1: Faint Aura (2-3 kills) 
- Passive: Speed I effect for enhanced mobility
- Visual: Soft particle effects surround the player, indicating their budding power

 Stage 2: Active Aura (4-5 kills) 
- Retains all Stage 1 benefits
- Passive: Stren

Single Mace Only - Plugin - Concept 
The Single Mace Only plugin is designed to keep gameplay simple and balanced by ensuring that only one Mace can ever exist on a server at any given time ⚔️.

When a player crafts or obtains the first Mace (even through creative or commands), it is marked as the unique Mace. At that moment, the plugin sends a server-wide announcement with bold on-screen titles, chat messages, and fitting sound effects 🔔.

While the unique Mace exists, no other mace can be created. Any attempt to craft or spawn another is blocked or instantly removed, keeping the one-Mace rule intact.

If the unique Mace is ever destroyed—whether by breaking, burning, falling into the void, despawning, or any other cause—the plugin broadcasts its destruction with dramatic titles, chat, and sounds 🐉. From that point on, crafting is unlocked again and another Mace can be forged.
